create_Resize_transform: create a Resize transform to resize image samples to a target width and height with optional aspect ratio
create_NormalizeImage_transform: create a NormalizeImage transform to normalize image pixel values by given mean and standard deviation
create_PrepareForNet_transform: create a PrepareForNet transform to transpose and cast image samples for neural network input
use_apply_min_size: use apply_min_size to resize a sample dict to ensure minimum dimensions while keeping aspect ratio
create_ShiftImage_transform: create a ShiftImage_w or ShiftImage_h transform to horizontally or vertically shift an image sample
